title: Study of the Influence of Ductal Carcinoma in Situ on the Outcome of Invasive Breast Cancer
brief_summary: A prospective observational longitudinal study of 464 patients was performed between 2010 and 2015. Patients with invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and ductal carcinoma in situ associated to invasive ductal carcinoma (DCIS +IDC) were included and analyzed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with invasive ductal carcinoma of the breast
* Patients who received surgery for primary invasive breast cancer between 2010 and 2015

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with metastasis at the diagnostic
study_population: The population included in the study was 464 patients. IDC was present in 221 patients (47.6%) and IDC + DCIS was present in 243 patients (52.4%).
